name: What types of flooring are suitable for a basement?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring are suitable for a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: For basements, it's crucial to select flooring materials that can withstand moisture and humidity, which are common issues in subterranean spaces. Good options include Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP), engineered hardwood with a waterproof core, tile (ceramic or porcelain), and certain types of sealed concrete. These materials offer durability and resistance to water damage, mold, and mildew. Carpet and solid hardwood are generally not recommended due to their susceptibility to moisture-related problems. Considerations like insulation and subfloor preparation also play a vital role in preventing issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Suitable basement flooring includes Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP), engineered hardwood, tile, and sealed concrete, which resist moisture. Avoid carpet and solid hardwood due to humidity.
